    Concert information

    Lisa Batiashvili, Robin Ticciati and the Chamber Orchestra of Europe

    Tickets

    12. Jan 27, 20:00

    At the invitation of the Berliner Philharmoniker

    Info

    Jean Sibelius’s Violin Concerto is one of Lisa Batiashvili’s signature pieces. With her interpretation of the work, as brilliant as it is deeply felt, the violinist won the 2nd Prize of the Sibelius Competition and began her international career. This evening, the concerto is preceded by Lotta Wennäkoski’s Verdigris – a shimmering play of sound and a subtle homage to Sibelius. To mark the 200th anniversary of Beethoven’s death, conductor Robin Ticciati and the Chamber Orchestra of Europe also perform his Fifth Symphony: from a striking four-note motif emerges one of music’s most compelling dramatic journeys, leading from darkness into light.

    Artists

    Chamber Orchestra of Europe
    Robin Ticciati conductor
    Lisa Batiashvili violin

    Programme

    Lotta Wennäkoski
    Verdigris

    Jean Sibelius
    Concerto for Violin and Orchestra in D minor, op. 47

    Lisa Batiashvili violin

    Interval

    Ludwig van Beethoven
    Symphony No. 5 in C minor, op. 67

    Additional information

    Duration ca. 2 hours and 15 minutes (incl. 20 minutes interval)
